faqs.q: Sec. 14-121. - Removal of dog feces from certain areas.
faqs.a:
When any dog defecates upon any property other than that of the owner or custodian,
               including common areas of condominiums, townhouses, duplexes, or apartments, it shall
               be the duty of the owner or custodian of such dog immediately to remove and properly
               dispose of such feces, as outlined in
section 14-122
(b).
(Code 1981, § 6-60; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
